lines.zh: 我的根须拔起来，又插下去。
lines.en: My roots lift and plant again.
Each step shakes the ground.

lines.zh: 粉色的花瓣从我肩上落。
lines.en: Pink petals fall from my shoulders.
I drag two thick wooden legs.

lines.zh: 我走在樱花树林的坡上。
lines.en: I walk the slopes of the cherry grove.

lines.zh: 枝条在我头顶擦出声音。
lines.en: The branches scrape above my head.

lines.zh: 我绕过自己掉下的落花。
lines.en: I step around my own fallen petals.
One stride carries me over the stream.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，花瓣跟着旋。
lines.en: Turning slowly, I stir the petals.

lines.zh: 我的树皮缝里还嵌着石头。
lines.en: Stones are still lodged in my bark.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草地会自己合上。
lines.en: The grass closes after my steps.
Standing, I am simply a tree.

lines.zh: 春天在我身上过得很慢。
lines.en: Spring passes slowly through me.

lines.zh: 花瓣落在我肩上，我不拂。
lines.en: Petals settle on me and I do not brush them.

lines.zh: 我把根须慢慢伸进土里。
lines.en: I ease my roots into the soil.
I hear sap moving inside me.
I wait for one blossom to fall.

lines.zh: 鸟在我膝边的枝条上筑巢。
lines.en: Birds nest on the branch by my knee.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，也不觉得闷。
lines.en: I am still, and not bored.
One more ring has grown in me.

lines.zh: 这具身体比普通树精更结实。
lines.en: This body is tougher than an ordinary ent.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬起一只手，接住花。
lines.en: I lift a hand slowly to catch a blossom.

lines.zh: 风把我的枝梢吹得很轻。
lines.en: The wind moves my twigs gently.
I count the fallen blossoms.

lines.zh: 我的树心里有很老的纹。
lines.en: There are very old lines in my heartwood.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，也是树的模样。
lines.en: Even with my eyes shut, I am a tree.
The earth is warm; it feels good.

lines.zh: 很久没有人走到这儿了。
lines.en: No one has come this way in a long while.

lines.zh: 我的枝条上停着两只蝶。
lines.en: Two butterflies rest on my branches.

lines.zh: 你站在我影子里，像一朵花。
lines.en: You stand in my shadow like a blossom.
I smell iron when you come near.
I bend a branch down to you.
This bark does not part easily.
Are you picking blossoms?
My branches move on their own.

lines.zh: 你脚下那些花瓣，是我的。
lines.en: The petals at your feet are mine.

lines.zh: 你不该在这片林里点火的。
lines.en: You should not light fires in this grove.
I know every tree here.
Your prints press into the fallen petals.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，你能听见木响。
lines.en: I raise a hand and you hear wood creak.
It has been long since I was cut.
You cut into my bark.
I step back slowly.
That cut was not deep.
A dull sound comes from my heartwood.
I sway my branches once.
It hurts, but trees endure pain.
You put real strength into that.
More blossoms fall.
I still stand, and I can still grow.
I only want the sun.
Why are you digging there?
That is not water; that is oil.

lines.zh: 你把东西收起来，我就走。
lines.en: Put it away and I will go.
What interests me is the soil.
That smell is too sharp.
What I want is soil and water.

lines.zh: 你要是浇点水，我会高兴。
lines.en: Pour a little water and I will be glad.
You hit my leg and fall back.
This body of wood will not budge.

lines.zh: 我们都晃了一下，我没倒。
lines.en: We both sway; I do not fall.
Your shoulder knocks off a piece of bark.
I step back and the ground follows.
Petals scatter everywhere.
You are light, like a bird.

lines.zh: 撞完你才看见我有多粗。
lines.en: Now you see how thick I am.
I step aside; go on.
Ents do not come in pairs.
I flower, and that is enough.
Our roots join underground on their own.
You ask about the habits of animals.
I sway my branches slowly.
I do not understand this.
My season has not come.

lines.zh: 我只和这片林子有关系。
lines.en: My only bond is with this grove.
I turn my head back to the sun.
Let it pass.
I bend over, my wood creaking.
I pick up that fallen blossom.
It is caught between my knuckles.
I tuck it into my bark.
I cannot hold anything too heavy.
I put it in the hollow.
It is soft in my hand.
I look at it, then set it back on the soil.
I cover it with a little moss.
Pick it up or not, as you like.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，就在花树之间。
lines.en: I see you, there among the blossoms.
You broke one of my branches.
My roots begin to reach.

lines.zh: 这片林子我看了几百年。
lines.en: I have watched this grove for centuries.
I lift my head and the canopy rustles.
You have cut enough today.
I turn slowly this way.
Your torch is too near the trees.
The petals fall, and I move.
I follow one step at a time.
Each step shakes down a layer of petals.
You run between two trees.
I reach a branch across to block you.
I need not run; the land is with me.
You have backed to the stream.
I cannot walk past the water.
I wait on the bank.
Sooner or later you must come back.
I sweep a branch across.
The branch lands heavy on you.
I raise a hand and throw up soil.
That was wood striking wood.

lines.zh: 你砍进我的树皮，我退了。
lines.en: You cut into my bark and I withdraw.
I trip you with a root.
Petals are shaken down all around.
I raise both arms slowly.
You cannot stand, and I do not press.
Enough; go.

lines.zh: 我从樱花树林的土里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the soil of the cherry grove.

lines.zh: 我的根一寸寸拔出地面。
lines.en: My roots pull out of the ground inch by inch.

lines.zh: 花瓣先落下来，然后我动。
lines.en: The petals fall first; then I move.

lines.zh: 这具身体有一百六十点血。
lines.en: This body holds a hundred and sixty.
My head reaches the treetops.

lines.zh: 风里有春天和铁的味道。
lines.en: The wind smells of spring and iron.
I stretch my bark open.
The blossoms here know me.
I work my wooden joints.
Footsteps have come in again.
I am here to watch this grove.
Right; I will stand where there is sun.

lines.zh: 火苗顺着我的树皮往上爬。
lines.en: Flame climbs the bark of me.

lines.zh: 我砸在地上，根断了几条。
lines.en: I crash down and several roots snap.

lines.zh: 水浸透我的木头，沉得厉害。
lines.en: Water soaks my wood and I grow heavy.
The blast snaps half my arm.
An arrow sticks in the bark of my shoulder.
That force reaches my growth rings.

lines.zh: 没有阳光和土，我慢慢沉下去。
lines.en: No sun and no soil, and I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我的树冠上，烧焦一片。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my crown and burns it black.
I fall roots and all, breaking on the way.
